data: Microsoft reported revenue of $245.1 billion for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, up 16% from $211.9 billion in fiscal 2023 (about $33.2 billion of growth). Net income for fiscal 2024 was $88.1 billion, up 22% from $72.4 billion in fiscal 2023. These figures are from my recollection of Microsoft's fiscal 2024 annual results rather than a live check of the filing, so confirm them against the Form 10-K if you need exact numbers.
